context.transcript:
Zoya, I've reviewed the quarterly report from the sales group for our line of sports shoes.
Our company's attracted a large number of new customers.
I'm impressed.
Well, I spent a lot of time putting together my advertising team.
Now, the report also indicates that we've had more returns as well.
Customers who are more serious runners have complained that there isn't enough arch support in the running shoes.
You know, we make arch support inserts and most of our stores carry them.
I'll make sure we ship them to every retail location.
context.transcript_translation:
佐雅，我审查了销售部门关于我们的运动鞋系列的季度报告。
我们公司吸引了一批大量的新客户。
我很印象深刻。
嗯，我花了很多时间组建我的广告团队。
现在，这份报告还指出我们也有更多的退货。
一些更认真的跑步者抱怨说跑鞋缺乏足够的足弓支撑。
你知道，我们生产足弓支撑垫，大多数门店都备有这些。
我会确保把它们运送到每个零售地点。
